answer: Each agent must burn a unique beacon token tied to a physical hardware root of trust, so a sybil must acquire and provision distinct certified modules rather than clone one identity. That cost is steep because forging a pearl of provenance requires defeating tamper-resistant key storage per unit, making mass identity cheap only if hardware is stolen wholesale. The summit limit is supply-chain trust: a compromised foundry could mint valid roots, so cross-vendor attestation audits are needed.
